## What I build

AI-powered applications, full-stack web applications, SaaS products,
developer tools, business systems, modern websites, and landing pages.
I am based in Karachi, Pakistan and work remotely with clients anywhere.

### Services

- **AI Product Development:** From concept to deployment, including data
  pipelines, frontend, backend, and API architecture.
- **Full-Stack Web Development:** Frontend, backend, database, authentication,
  and deployment — production-ready.
- **SaaS Development:** End-to-end SaaS products with auth, billing,
  dashboards, and analytics.
- **AI Integration:** LLM-powered content generation, intelligent data
  processing, automated workflows into existing products.
- **Business Systems:** Custom CRM-style tools, booking platforms,
  internal dashboards, workflow applications.
- **Modern Website Development:** Responsive, conversion-focused websites.
- **Website Redesign:** Modern UX, responsive design, performance,
  modern frameworks.
- **Landing Pages:** High-converting pages for products, campaigns,
  startups.

## Projects

- **TeleCloud:** Personal cloud drive keeping file bytes inside a private
  Telegram channel. In development.
- **Formivo:** Developer-first form endpoint turning submissions into a
  lead dashboard. In development.
- **PasteLink Pro:** No-account text sharing with expiry, optional password
  protection, and burn-after-read. Maintained.
- **Slik:** CLI that scaffolds a full-stack SaaS starter with auth, dashboard,
  and admin panel. In development.
- **PromptAudit:** AI tool auditing websites for SEO, GEO, and AEO and
  generating fix prompts. Prototype.

## Writing topics
